SPECIFICATION

FOR

DECORTICATED GROUNDNUT OILCAKE AS LIVESTOCK FEED INGREDIENT

( Second Revision )
0. FOREWORD

0.1 This Indian Standard ( Second Revision ) was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 31 January 1986, after the draft finalized by the Animal Feeds Sectional Committee had been approved by the Agriculturai and Food Products Division Council. 0.2 This standard was first issued in 1960. With the adoption of improved expelling processes and also due to problems having arisen due to aflatoxin in groundnut oilcake, a need was felt for revising the Indian Standard. The first revision, therefore, was issued in 1970. In the present revision, requirements of the material are being up-dated along with its test methods. 0.3 Groundnut. oilcake is one of the best protein supplements for livestock feeding and is extensively used in feed concentrates and feed mixtures for livestock. It is expected that this standard would assist in making available this important ingredient of a suitable quality to the compound feed manfacturers. This standard applies to oilcake obtained by expelling well-hulled or shelled groundnut kernels. 0.4 Inclusion of the aflatoxin limit in the standard did not tind favour with the committee at this stage because of the non-availability of a reliable and quick method for its determination. Further, data for %xing a safe limit in the product meant for livestock feed was also not available. However, it was a considered view of the committee for fixing this limit as early as possible. 0.5 For the purpose of deciding whether a particular requirement of this standard is complied with, the final value, observed or calculated, ,expreeeing 3
"

IS:1713 - 1986 the result of a test or analysis, shall be rounded off in accordance with IS : 2-1960*. The number of significant places retained in the rounded off value should be the same as that of the specified value in this standard.

1. SCOPE I.1 This standard prescribes the requirements sampling and test for expeller pressed decorticated as livestock feed ingredient. 2. GRADES 2.1 Expeller pressed decorticated groundnut oilcake shall be of two grades namely, Grade I and Grade II. 3. REQUIREMENTS 3.1 Description - Expeller pressed decorticated groundnut oilcake shall It shall be free from rancidity, adulterants, insect or be of firm texture. visible fungus infestation and from fermented, musty or other objectionable It shall also be free from extraneous matter and metallic pieces. odour. 3.2 The material Table 1. shall also conform to the requirements prescribed in and the groundnut methods of oilcake used

4. PACKING AND MARKING 4.1 Packing L- Unless otherwise agreed to between the purchaser and the vendor, the material shall be packed in clean and sound jute bags or HDPE bags. The bags shall be securely closed with strong twine. 4.2 Marking - Each bag shall be indelibly and legibly marked to give the following information: a) b) e) d) e) Name and grade of the material; Name of the manufacturer; Batch or code number; Net mass in kg, when packed; and Date of packing.
